b: I've pondered weight loss for a long time but finally felt ready to start making some sustainable lifestyle changes. Just started a journey with intermittent fasting. I began in October, and today I've officially graduated from Obese to just plain overweight! Feels like a huge achievement for me since realizing my BMI landed me in the Obese category 4-5 years ago.

For the first few weeks I challenged myself to do strict 12:8 intermittent fasting, fasts starting at 8pm and lasting til 12pm the next day. It was hard, but I felt motivated by the challenge of it. After ~2 weeks of success, I realized I'd managed to break two bad habits that had been keeping me back for years (late night snack-binging, and overeating early mornings when I actually felt tired and not hungry). Since then I'm not as strict with the fasts, ie have coffee with cream in the morning and such, but I'm still seeing a lot of progress from breaking those bad habits! Intermittent fasting was really the key I needed I think, gives me some structure, which reduces food noise and makes it easier to make nutritious food choices during my eating window.
Anyways. Just feeling proud of myself today!!!
